description: Course Blockchain fundamental -> expert. Lessons first, quiz later. Vietnamese content, English terms. Rigorous hands-on (Foundry/ZK/full-stack) + capstones.

parts.title: Blockchain la gi? Song cai phan tan & double-spending
Ham bam (SHA-256) & cay Merkle
Mat ma khoa cong khai & chu ky so (ECDSA/EdDSA)
Cau truc block & chain, tinh bat bien
Vi, khoa, dia chi, seed phrase (BIP-32/39/44)
He phan tan & bai toan Byzantine Generals
Proof of Work: mining, difficulty, nonce
Proof of Stake: validator, slashing, finality
Cac co che khac: DPoS, PBFT, Tendermint, Avalanche
Fork choice, finality, P2P & mempool
Mo hinh UTXO, cau truc giao dich, phi
Bitcoin Script, SegWit, Taproot
Lightning Network (Layer 2 Bitcoin)
Account model, EVM, gas & opcode
Solidity co ban: storage/memory/calldata
Vong doi contract, ABI, event, deploy
Chuan token: ERC-20/721/1155/4626
CAPSTONE 1: Viet & deploy ERC-20 + ERC-721 co test
Foundry/Hardhat: viet, test, deploy
Design patterns: access control, proxy nang cap
Oracle (Chainlink) & toi uu gas
Lo hong: reentrancy, overflow, front-running, delegatecall
Case study cac vu hack lon (DAO/Parity/Ronin/Wormhole)
Quy trinh audit: Slither, Echidna, formal verification
CAPSTONE 2: Audit contract co lo hong, viet report
AMM & liquidity pool (Uniswap x*y=k), impermanent loss
Lending/borrowing (Aave/Compound), stablecoin
Flash loan, yield farming, derivatives & rui ro DeFi
CAPSTONE 3: Build AMM mini (Uniswap V2 clone)
